key_insight: Func-R1 addresses a key failure mode in multimodal math reasoning: models often miss or misread visual cues in function problems, so it jointly strengthens perception and theoretical reasoning.
engineering_relevance: The paper suggests that decoupling visual evidence extraction from reasoning, then aligning policy updates with theory, can improve MLLM reliability on visually grounded STEM tasks.
method: Explicitly decoupled architecture separates perception from reasoning.
Hierarchical post-training progressively identifies critical visual evidence and then performs deeper theoretical reasoning.
Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization (PATO) updates policies to internalize mathematical properties while correcting visual information during reasoning.
evidence_signal: Across diverse benchmarks, Func-R1 achieves the best performance among open-source MLLMs and reports an 8.4% gain over GPT-5 on MathVerse function-oriented tasks.
watch_item: Results are benchmark-dependent, so practical gains may vary when visual layouts are noisier or the function representation differs from the evaluation data.
paper_title: Func-R1: Incentivizing Mathematical Function Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
